name: MassivesoftWeapons
teaser: Collection of my and saintdeer's weapons for SPT 4.0.0+
description_html:
Overview

Collection of most of my weapon mod posted and and saintdeer’s GRAU.

Included Weapons:

  • 🔹 (New) Katana Nikitakiri
  • 🔹 (New) FSS Hurricane 5.7x28 Submachine Gun
  • 🔹 (New) Tempus 725 12ga Double-Barrel Shotgun
  • 🔹 (New) Kalashnikov "RPKN" 7.62x39 Light Machine Gun
  • 🔹 (New) JAK AR-15 5.56x45 Assault Rifle
  • 🔹 BAL-27 5.7x28 Assualt Rifle
  • 🔹 DG-56 5.56x45 Assualt Rifle
  • 🔹 GRAU 5.56x45/7.62x39 Rifles
  • 🔹 ISO .45ACP/9x19 Submachinguns
  • 🔹 ISO Hemlock 5.56x45/7.62x51/.300blk Assualt Rifles
  • 🔹 JAK-12 12ga Automatic Shotgun
  • 🔹 KATT AMR .50 BMG Bolt-action Rifle
  • 🔹 Longbow 7.62x39 Bolt-action Rifle
  • 🔹 M14 7.62x51 Rifle
  • 🔹 MCW 5.56x45 Assualt Rifles
  • 🔹 MCX 5.56x45 Barrel
  • 🔹 MHG Hand Grenades
  • 🔹 New COD Mags from MW
  • 🔹 QBZ-03 5.56x45 Assualt Rifle
  • 🔹 QBZ-97 5.56x45 Assualt Rifle
  • 🔹 Superi46 4.6x30 Submachinegun
  • 🔹 TR75/76/77 Assualt Rifles
  • 🔹 Type 64 7.62x25 Slienced Submachinegun
  • 🔹 Vector .308 Assualt Rifle
  • 🔹 CQ-A 5.56x45 Assault Rifle
  • 🔹 Molot Arms VPO-209 FA .366 TKM Carbine
  • 🔹 Various New Ammo

All sound bundles have been rebuilt to fix the issue where gunfire sounds did not change according to the environment (indoor/outdoor)

Installation

Decompress and put the folder SPT under [Your EFT Directory]/

Notice

  • Not completely compatible with profile created with AmightyTank’s Massivesoft Gun due to the inconsistent ID used by GRAU. Remove anything related with GRAU might work.

  • Tavor X95 & X95-R is not included since WTT have a better one.

  • To disable a certain component, remove the coresponding folder under MassivesoftWeapons/subs/

  • Theoretically compatible with Fika and WTT-armory. Not fully tested. No guarantee.

  • All models, textures, audio and animations ported from other games belongs to their respective original owner. No commercial use of this mod is allowed.
